h:
这是使用 Anima 生成图像的简单工作流程。此工作流程不包含任何复杂的节点，例如细节人员或雇用前和雇用后固定节点。

特点

  • 使用efficiency-node可以在生成时快速预览图像。如果生成的图像不满足您的需求，它可以通过中断（取消）工作流程来节省时间。

  • 有第二次增强（HiRes Fix）生成的图像。

  • 具有 LoRA 堆栈来添加所需的 LoRA。第一级和第二级都有可以使用的LoRA级。

  • 安全级别选择器，用于在生成图像的安全级别之间进行选择。

  • 用于标签引用的 WD14 标记器（可选）。

型号

基础模型（包括VAE/CLIP（文本编码器））

    • CLIP（文本编码器）（Circlestone-labs/Anima 主要页面）在页面下载safetensor文件。

      • 将其放置在 \ComfyUI\models\text_encoders 中

    • VAE（Circlestone-labs/Anima 主要页面）在页面下载safetensor文件。

      • 将其放置在 \ComfyUI\models\vae 中

高档型号

  • RealESRGAN_x4Plus 动漫 6B - v1 |升级产品 升级产品 |奇维泰

o.en:
This is a simple workflow for generating an image using Anima. This workflow does not contain any complex nodes like detailers or pre- and post-hires fixing nodes.

Features

  • Use efficiency-node so you can quickly preview the image when generating. It can save time by interrupting (cancelling) the workflow if the generated image does not satisfy what you desired.

  • Has a 2nd pass to enhance (HiRes Fix) the generated image.

  • Has a LoRA stack to add desired LoRAs. Both the first stage and the 2nd stage have LoRA stages that can be used.

  • A safe level selector to choose between the safe levels of the generated image.

  • A WD14 Tagger (Optional) for tag referencing.

Models

Base Model (Including VAE/CLIP(Text Encoder))

  • Anima - aesthetic-v1.1 | Anima Checkpoint | Civitai

    • Download the diffusion model on the page

      • Place it in the <Comfyui root>\ComfyUI\models\diffusion_models

    • CLIP (text encoder) (circlestone-labs/Anima at main) Download the safetensor file on the page.

      • Place it in the <Comfyui root>\ComfyUI\models\text_encoders

    • VAE (circlestone-labs/Anima at main) Download the safetensor file on the page.

      • Place it in the <Comfyui root>\ComfyUI\models\vae

Upscale Model

  • RealESRGAN_x4Plus Anime 6B - v1 | Upscaler Upscaler | Civitai

    • Place it in the <Comfyui root>\ComfyUI\models\upscale_models
